name: Peanut Butter, Banana & Cinnamon Tortilla Roll-Ups
instructions: Place tortillas on a cutting board, then spread peanut butter evenly over each tortilla.
Peel bananas and place at one end of each tortilla. Roll each tortilla up around the banana, then slice crosswise into 1-inch rounds.
To serve, divide roll-ups between plates and sprinkle with cinnamon. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
